AW-STUDY-0031 · Moon Base Kit · round 1

The Moon base, built to walk through

200 low-poly pieces proposed for the low-gravity Moon shooter, and the first 20 built: 41,192 triangles in all. Each one is made of named parts with real materials. Panel seams, brushed metal and rock pits are baked into colour, roughness and normal maps, so they still look solid up close in first person. Every part also knows its own mass, so low gravity can throw it honestly.

The look follows the Moon Heroes "Faceted Hero" direction: flat planes, gunmetal and off-white hull, orange for people and warm windows, green, amber and red lamps for state. Cyan is kept for the Star Child and crystals, and gold for Daddy's memory coins. The heroes, buggy and lander belong to the Moon Heroes study.

The 20, built

Left: the three-quarter view. Tap "Spin it" to turn the real model. Right: what Abbie sees from her own eye height, which is the view that matters in first person. These were drawn in Blender tonight because the Mac was offline; Midjourney proofs for all 20 are queued for morning, and round 2 rebuilds each piece against its pick from the same camera.

MK-001

Solar array wing

A gunmetal mast on an anchored foot, a slewing head, a torque tube and two wings of four framed cells each, tilted to the low lunar sun. A junction box at the foot carries the green "power good" lamp (diegetic: if the base is short of power, these lamps go amber).

How each piece is made

  1. Parts that build the system. Every piece is assembled from named parts (Hatch, LockWheel, StateRing), so you can ask for a change in words, and the game can animate a single part.
  2. Low poly, hero up close. Most pieces are 300 to 3,000 triangles with crisp chamfers. The detail lives in baked maps: base colour, roughness and normal, at 512 or 1024 px.
  3. Material is meaning. Material names are game roles (Metal_Hull, Glass_Window, OrangeBand, Lamp_Green), and each role has a real density. So every part carries its mass in the model file.
  4. The world tells you. Gauges, lamp posts, door light rings, charge bars and frost lines carry air, power and safety. The shooter can run without a HUD bar.
  5. Built for Abbie's size. Everything is checked from 1.1 m eye height. Consoles have a kid step, and the lower bunk and the lettuce tier sit at her height.

Next

Midjourney proofs for the 20 come next, then round 2 against your picks. After that: the five base buildings the Moon Heroes study handed over (dome, tower, habitat and hangar, airlock, supply crate), and then placing the kit on the Moon tile for the shooter.
